# Community health — where to find what

| Need | Where |
|------|-------|
| Report a security vulnerability | [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) → Security tab → GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting (Security tab) |
| Report a bug | [Open an issue](https://github.com/Kayforkind/reimagine-it/issues/new?labels=bug) |
| Propose a feature or a new direction | [Open an issue](https://github.com/Kayforkind/reimagine-it/issues/new?labels=enhancement) first for anything large |
| Contribute code or a proof example | [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) — protected-main flow, the CI Gate, and the submission lane |
| Code of conduct | [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) |
| Ask a question | [Discussions](https://github.com/Kayforkind/reimagine-it/discussions) or an issue labeled `question` |
| Roadmap | [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md) |
